title: AltRA-Test: An Alternative Annotator Test for LLM Judges Without Shared Annotators
abstract: arXiv:2611.26073v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as judges and graders to replace human annotators, raising the question of when such replacement is statistically justified. To support such decisions, the Alternative Annotator Test (Alt-Test) was introduced for dense settings where all items are annotated by the same annotators. However, in many large-scale annotation settings, items are annotated by different subsets of annotators. We therefore propose the Alternative Annotator Test with Resampled Annotations (AltRA-Test), a statistical test that does not require that all items are annotated by the same annotators. AltRA-Test uses a bootstrap that resamples items, draws k human annotations for each item, and substitutes one of them with an LLM annotation. This produces paired all-human and mixed human-LLM panels. A replacement is supported when the inter-annotator agreement (IAA) of the mixed panel is statistically non-inferior to t

translated_title: AltRA-Test：一种无需共享标注者的LLM评判者替代标注者检验
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被用作评判者和评分者来替代人类标注者，这引发了一个问题：这种替代在何时具有统计学上的合理性。为了支持此类决策，此前提出了替代标注者检验，适用于所有条目均由相同标注者标注的密集场景。然而，在许多大规模标注场景中，条目是由不同的标注者子集进行标注的。为此，我们提出了基于重采样标注的替代标注者检验，这是一种不要求所有条目均由相同标注者标注的统计检验方法。AltRA-Test采用自助法重采样条目，为每个条目抽取k个人类标注，并将其中一个替换为LLM标注，从而生成配对的全人类标注组与人类-LLM混合标注组。当混合标注组的标注者间一致性在统计学上不劣于全人类标注组时，即支持进行替换。
tldr: 提出了AltRA-Test统计检验方法，通过自助法重采样克服条目由不同标注者子集标注的限制，从而判断用LLM替代人类标注者在统计学上是否合理。
en_tdlr: AltRA-Test is a bootstrap-based statistical test that determines when replacing human annotators with LLM judges is statistically justified, even when items are annotated by different subsets of annotators.
